title: The Harbor Light
tagline: A compact coastal mystery about a missing lighthouse keeper and a signal that should not exist.
ready_copy: The harbor is waiting. Create your investigator, then step onto the pier.
case_note: A private table is prepared for this run. Name your investigator, follow the harbor trail, and answer in free-form actions when the Keeper asks what you do next.

beats.title: Fogbound Pier
beats.copy: Question the constable and search the place where Elias Rook vanished.

beats.title: The Broken Light
beats.copy: Read the keeper notes, inspect the lens, and decide what the signal means.

beats.title: Dawn Choice
beats.copy: End the count quietly or break the lighthouse before the harbor answers.

character_presets.background: A city investigator sent to Graymouth after two winter disappearances were quietly closed as accidents.
A freelance reporter chasing harbor folklore, missing-person files, and the strange rhythm of the lighthouse beam.
A practical dockside repair hand who knows engines, storm damage, and which locals are lying about the old light.
